name: Nero Agent
summary: Voice and text assistant with web, reviewed Mac tools and independent MCP connections.
capabilities: Uses a dedicated installed Codex runtime and its own ChatGPT sign-in
Sends your messages, conversation context and permitted Nook data when you enable Nook context
Proposes permitted module actions for your review
On-demand Mac window reads; screenshots and control operations require review and macOS permissions
Keeps watches and activity on this Mac; selected context starts local-only
Explicit voice conversations through a permitted local speech plugin; recognized words use this Agent account, audio stays local; no direct microphone access
Cited-answer actions use supplied transcript text and recent chat context; no tools, action proposals or inherited personal chat.
Live web search and explicitly connected local/remote MCP tools; separate sign-in; tool results can be sent to the agent account
